question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **performing**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given words.

 
 
• **Prospering**: Succeed in material terms; be financially successful. (सफल)
 
• **Acknowledging**: Accept or admit the existence or truth of. (यह स्वीकार करते हुए)
 
• **Rectifying**: To correct something or make something right. (संशोधन करना)
 
• **Performing**: Carry out, accomplish, or fulfil an action, task, or function. (प्रदर्शन)
 
 
 
• So, as per the meaning of the given words "**performing**" is the most appropriate option.
 
• The implied meaning of the sentence is: Symptoms include forgetting basic everyday chores and completing familiar duties like driving or baking.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is option 4.
